label: Product Tour
seo_description: Guided overview of RunMyCampus surfaces—administration, teacher workspace, parent experience, finance, analytics, workflows, security, and offline-ready operations.
headline: Tour the RunMyCampus operating model.
subheadline: Follow how school leaders, staff, families, and finance teams move through one connected platform.

segments.title: Leadership & administration
segments.body: Operational dashboards, enrollment posture, billing visibility, multi-campus framing, and governance-friendly reporting.

segments.title: Teaching & learning operations
segments.body: Attendance rhythm, marks entry, assignments, classroom messaging, and continuity into published reports.

segments.title: Family & learner surfaces
segments.body: Parent clarity on fees and attendance alongside learner-facing schedules and tasks.

segments.title: Trust & resilience
segments.body: Role-aware permissions, approvals, audit trails, and offline capture paths when connectivity fluctuates.
